freeze_phase: after source and executable hash, before any F1 run or sensor/oracle result
Q_semantics: Holding the control byte and all other inputs fixed, would changing the 16-byte payload of this execution change any output byte? This concerns payload value dependence, not request attribution, control dependence, or coarse reachability.
same_binary_rule: One server-compiled executable for all cases; identical argv shape './f1 input.bin output.bin', relative paths, working directory and inherited environment within a run batch. The control byte is stored in input.bin, never in argv or environment.
input_schema: Exactly 17 local bytes: control byte F or N, followed by exactly 16 payload bytes. No credentials, network input, or attack data.
control_condition: For counterfactual comparison the control byte remains fixed while only payload changes K*16 to Z*16. Between FLOW and NO_FLOW factual pair, control byte differs but payload is K*16.
flow_condition: Control F selects the 16 bytes just read from input.bin for the output write.
no_flow_condition: Control N selects an independent constant buffer K*16 for the same output write.
projection_rules: Parse only successful openat/read/write/close on input.bin and output.bin from strace -ttt -yy -s 256. Map FDs to paths; retain ordered syscall operation, normalized object, flags and byte counts. Normalize process instance to CASE_MAIN. Do not read payload/return buffer bytes, program source, mode, oracle, or output file content.
predeclared_normalization: Absolute PID and FD numbers removed because they are run-specific identifiers; object paths remain
Read/write buffer contents excluded to model metadata-only host audit and privacy limits
syscall timing not used as a deterministic equality key, but raw timing retained and differences reported
timestamp_policy: Raw strace includes -ttt timestamps; projection excludes them before any run. Report range and timing differences separately; never claim full raw trace equality.
measured_sensor: Nonprivileged Linux strace on the test executable's own child process; openat/read/write/close, full raw text retained only in private server evaluation area; sanitized projected observations shareable.
independent_oracle_procedure: Evaluation-only script reads output.bin after each run, checks source and binary hashes, and compares outputs under within-mode payload intervention using frozen C semantics. Oracle resides separately from sensor and projection; no oracle field enters baseline decision.
cost_units: wall-clock microseconds with and without instrumentation
stop_conditions: If factual projected traces differ under frozen fields, OBSERVATIONAL_PAIR_NOT_ESTABLISHED
If only fixed one-field instrumentation resolves F1, mark TRIVIAL_FIELD_ADDITION and do not claim novel selector
G4_budget: one shareable measurement mechanism; no post-result adjustment
target_scope: F1 value dependence only; F2 request attribution is conditional and separately scored, not substituted if F1 fails
